desc: command-line utility converting the SASLDB database from BerkeleyDB to the database format currently used bys sasldb.
r: cyrusbdb2current - command-line utility converting the SASLDB database from BerkeleyDB to the database format currently used bys sasldb.

cyrusbdb2current converts the current sasldb database from BerkeleyDB format to the currently used database format. It is STRONGLY RECOMMENDED to make a backup of the current database before the conversion.

We expect that the old path is /etc/sasldb2 and the new one is /etc/sasl2/sasldb2
